title: SPINE ISN'T THE ONLY SPINE IN THE 2D INDUSTRY ANYMORE.
author: Scared-Sandwich1283

comments.author: RedGhostMail
comments.body: esiste un tool gratuito professinale chiamato dragonbone gia da una vita

replies.author: Scared-Sandwich1283
replies.body: True, DragonBones is a classic, but it's been abandoned for years and lacks modern pipeline integration. This one opens existing DragonBones and Spine files directly, and is built on Tauri 2 with a deterministic solver architecture and a built-in MCP server for modern pipelines, plus native open-source runtimes for Unity, Godot, Cocos, Phaser, JS, and Rust.

replies.author: Scared-Sandwich1283
replies.body: Yes, natively! We ship both an ⁠.AppImage⁠ (works on any distro) and a ⁠.deb⁠ package on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jaisurya-dev-art/rigby2d/releases/latest), plus the full editor runs directly in any browser with zero install at [rigby2d.com/editor](https://rigby2d.com/editor/). It also opens existing DragonBones (⁠\_ske.json⁠) projects natively, so you don't need Wine to work with DragonBones files on Linux anymore.
